reserveReview.rationale: YO's live API (lastUpdated 2026-10-27) identifies the Base vault asset as USDC and lists its deployed positions as Morpho lending markets: cbBTC/USDC 64.31%, WETH/USDC 31.87%, and a wstETH/USDT market 0.55% of invested balance. The Base vault was read on-chain at block 53150776 (2026-10-27T08:48:19Z): USDC balanceOf(vault) 158,703.944184 against totalAssets 7,544,164.796309, so idle is 2.103664865084% and deployed 97.896335134916%. The idle row is direct USDC, while the deployed row is a USDC-denominated protocol position exposed to the selected markets, strategy controls, and withdrawal liquidity.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Base ERC-4626 idle USDC balance and totalAssets read at block 53150776 (2026-10-27T08:48:19Z), with vault asset and strategy identities verified against YO's first-party API
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The deployed strategy set and weights can change; the live row is classified as the USDC-denominated YO strategy envelope rather than treated as direct idle USDC.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: YO identifies its vaults and whitelisted DeFi strategy venues but does not establish statutory segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or provider shares. Rehypothecation is marked permitted because the vault actively deploys deposits into lending and other DeFi strategies.
